text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The history and future of Umamusume.
And the
present. To think I'd be in such
an article.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look. Your name's here too, Trainer.
Well, of
course it is, since you've been
with me from the
start.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of statistics in here as
well. Not
that I really have the head for
them—I just run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to this magazine, it'll be like
everyone
from my hometown can have
me right next to
them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll have to do even better. I want
to make
it into a lot more articles.
